name: Wonder Pets!
description: When school ends for the day, Linny, Tuck and Ming-Ming -- an animated trio of classroom pets -- morph into heroes who sail the globe in their fantastic Flyboat and use teamwork to help pandas, elephants and other animals who are in trouble.

videos.title: Save The Dolphin!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Hawaii to save a Young Dolphin who has gotten caught in a fisherman's net.

videos.title: Save the Chimp!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets rig their Flyboat for space travel and head for the stars to rescue a Baby Chimp who is adrift in a rocket ship.

videos.title: Save the Unicorn!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets take a journey into a storybook to save a baby unicorn whose horn is stuck in a tree. But can they do it with a dragon hot on their trail?

videos.title: Save the Penguin!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Antarctica to save a penguin chick who is stranded in the middle of the ocean on a block of ice!

videos.title: Save the Sea Lions!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets save a pair of brother and sister sea lions in Alaska who are playing a game of tug-of-war on who gets the fish treat, too close to the water, on a windy day.

videos.title: Save the Kangaroo!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets save a pair of brother and sister sea lions in Alaska who are playing a game of tug-of-war on who gets the fish treat, too close to the water, on a windy day.

videos.title: Save the Caterpillar!
videos.overview: Linny, Tuck, and Ming-Ming try to help an inchworm understand what is going on when his friend, the caterpillar, undergoes the changes necessary to become a butterfly.

videos.title: Save the Crane!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets leaped into a Japanese painting to save a baby crane from an erupting volcano.

videos.title: Save the Duckling!
videos.overview: Linny and Tuck have to save Ming-Ming before it starts to rain after she gets stuck on the top of the schoolhouse building roof and unable to fly due to getting covered in sticky tree sap, just as she ventures out on her own by trying to help alongside with a baby squirrel in the tree outside the school.

videos.title: Save the Kitten!
videos.overview: The pets must save a kitten who is floating on a piece of driftwood in Venice, Italy.

videos.title: Save the Pigeon!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to New York to save a pigeon on the nose of the Statue of Liberty in New York.

videos.title: Save the Dinosaur!
videos.overview: Linny, Tuck and Ming-Ming are called into a dinosaur world to rescue a baby Triceratops who is stuck between two rocks. But the team would have to act quick as there was a Pteranodon standing on a boulder that would crash between the rocks.

videos.title: Save the Cow!
videos.overview: The pets travel to Oklahoma and try to save a calf that was thrown into a tree by a tornado. Based on the "Moo-sical," "Oklahoma!"

videos.title: Save the Skunk!
videos.overview: Linny, Tuck, and Ming-Ming save a skunk from a thorny rosebush with the help of Ollie the bunny. Ollie gets sprayed by the baby skunk when he frightened her by accident.￼

videos.title: Save the Swan!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets try to help a young swan who doesn't know how to dance.

videos.title: Save the Puppy!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a Golden Retriever puppy, Max, in Long Island use the doggy door.

videos.title: Save the Tree!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Philadelphia and save a young cherry tree by cleaning up the lot and planting a beautiful city garden with the help of other animals.

videos.title: Save the Elephant!
videos.overview: Linny, Tuck, and Ming-Ming travel to the grasslands of Kenya to help a baby elephant who is stuck in the mud.

videos.title: Save the Panda!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a baby panda who is stuck in a bamboo forest.

videos.title: Save the Mouse!
videos.overview: Ming-Ming and Tuck must save a baby mouse who is stuck inside a saxophone in the schoolhouse attic as Linny's condition makes her sneeze the whole time.

videos.title: Save the Camel!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets fly to Egypt to help a thirsty Baby Camel get home.

videos.title: Save the Ants!
videos.overview: Then the Wonder Pets try to stop two different armies of ants from fighting at a picnic.

videos.title: Save the Hedgehog!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets rescue a baby hedgehog inside a topiary.

videos.title: Save the Crocodile!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets visit to Egypt once again and help a baby crocodile who has a toothache.

videos.title: Save the Bullfrog!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help an elderly bullfrog.

videos.title: Save the Poodle!
videos.overview: Then the Wonder Pets must rescue a poodle from the top of the Eiffel Tower.

videos.title: Save the Sheep!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must stop a herd of sheep before they fall off the cliff.

videos.title: Save the Hermit Crab!
videos.overview: The Pets go on a vacation to Cancun, Mexico. While they are there, they discover a hermit crab that's in need of a new shell and decide to help out.

videos.title: Save the Black Kitten!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets receive a request for help from a kitten trapped inside a haunted doghouse.

videos.title: Save the Yak, the Pig, and the Dancing Bear!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a group of performing animals that have floated away in a hot air balloon.

videos.title: Save the Reindeer!
videos.overview: Linny, Ming-Ming, and Tuck must save one of Santa's reindeer that is stuck on the ice in the North Pole. They make a net out of Ming Ming's sweater and reel the baby reindeer in. Once they save the reindeer she ends up running away because she doesn't have the confidence to think she is good enough to help pull Santa's sleigh.

videos.title: Save the Three Little Pigs!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets join the world of fairy tale theater when they receive a call from The Three Little Pigs. The pigs are faced with a big, bad wolf who is trying to blow down their homes.

videos.title: Save the Owl!
videos.overview: Linny, Tuck and Ming Ming travel to Oregon to save an owl who is lost in the forrest.

videos.title: Save the Wonder Pets
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets set out to rescue a sea creature who lives underwater, but end up being swallowed by a giant whale, and need to be rescued themselves. A puffer fish, seahorse and squid come to their aid.

videos.title: Save the Goldfish!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must work together to save a baby goldfish in an aquarium is trapped inside a bubbling treasure chest.

videos.title: Save the Baby Birds!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets assist a group of baby birds in finding a perch.

videos.title: Save Little Red Riding Hood!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to the puppet theater to save Little Red Riding Hood. The Big Bad Wolf is chasing her, but she doesn't believe she's in any trouble. The wolf acts like he's friendly to trick her, plotting to eat her and her grandmother.

videos.title: Save the Turtle!
videos.overview: When Tuck the Turtle dreams of being somewhere other than the classroom, he ends up in the Caribbean Sea. Then he ends up stuck his foot on a coral reef. Ming-Ming and Linny must venture to the Caribbean to save him. It's a relaxing, sunny place, but they do their best to keep their minds on the job.

videos.title: Save the Egg!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets head to Yellowstone National Park to rescue an egg before it falls on the edge of a cliff.

videos.title: Save the Flamingo!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from a flamingo who is stuck in a marsh in a Jamaican coloring book.

videos.title: Save the Bee!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets shrink down to bee-sized to help a Baby Bee make her first collection of nectar for her hive.

videos.title: Save the Squirrel!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets receive a call from a squirrel who is trapped on a Ferris wheel at Coney Island. When they free the squirrel from the wheel, they discover that it seems to be lost, but is reluctant to ask for help. They also enjoy the delights of Coney Island while trying to persuade the squirrel.

videos.title: Save the Chameleon!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to the island of Madagascar to save a chameleon from a cuckoo hawk. Along the way, they try new ways of doing things and learn about the concept of camouflage.

videos.title: Save the Platypus!
videos.overview: When Ming-Ming appears out of nowhere inside Tuck's terrarium, she playfully messes with his things for her own amusement, to Tuck's dismay. Initially, Tuck is frustrated with Ming-Ming's antics, until it is the last straw when she deliberately rearranges his turtle sculpture into the shape of a duck, leading to an argument between the two. Tuck angrily declares that he is giving Ming-Ming the silent treatment, and unimpressed with this gesture, Ming-Ming angrily agrees. Nevertheless, the two plus Linny (who tries her best to dissolve the duo's argument) must still have the chance work together to help a platypus stuck on a river in Australia and restore their friendship.

videos.title: Save the Dragon!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets return to the Magical Land seen in Save the Unicorn! to rescue the baby dragon. The dragon is trapped on a cloud that is rapidly shrinking. They have to figure out a way for him to get down without getting hurt.

videos.title: Save the Beaver!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets need to help the beaver with a leaky dam. The resolution is when the Wonder Pets plug up the hole in the leaky dam.

videos.title: Save the Goslings!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Canada and help a family of Young Goslings learn to fly south by converting the Flyboat into a big Goose.

videos.title: Ollie to the Rescue!
videos.overview: Ollie, the bunny who once joined the Pets on a rescue, sets up his own animal-rescue service with a toy rock and frog. But when his plan backfires and he end up trapped in a birdfeeder along with a poor baby chipmunk, he was about to save! It's time for the Wonder Pets we all know to save the day as real heroes do!

videos.title: Save the Ladybug!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to the bogs of North Carolina to help a ladybug escape the closing leaves of a hungry Venus Flytrap.

videos.title: Save the Sea Turtle!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets head to Japan to help a lost sea turtle that is looking for any water to swim in.

videos.title: Save the Pangaroo!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a drawing of a pangaroo, a fictional animal that is part kangaroo and part parrot, who has been thrown away in the trash. They later help him find a home and a friend.

videos.title: Save the Cricket!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a cricket who is floating away in a bubble over the city of Chicago.

videos.title: Save the Armadillo!
videos.overview: An armadillo calls the Wonder Pets when he believes his town is haunted.

videos.title: Save the Itsy Bitsy Spider!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a distraught spider that keeping being flushed down the waterspout pole while being splashed in the rain.

videos.title: Save the Beetles!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets journey to Liverpool to save a band of mop-haired beetles who are trapped in a submarine and then go to the concert at the end.

videos.title: Three Wonder Pets and a Baby!
videos.overview: A piglet comes to live in the classroom, but the Wonder Pets each want to take care of it on their own. They realize they must work together to care for the rather large baby pig!

videos.title: Save the Gecko!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets play hide and seek with a gecko in Costa Rica and return to the classroom to find that the precocious gecko has come home with them!

videos.title: Save the Griffin!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must become brave knights to rescue a Baby Griffin in medieval England whose tail is stuck beneath a stone. Along the way, scaredy-cats Ming-Ming and Tuck learn the secrets of braveness.

videos.title: Here’s Ollie!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must shrink to the size of bees to help one who is having trouble making nectar. When she has problems with flying, they try to help her learn. Everyone discovers the value of practice. The Wonder Pets receive a call from a squirrel who is trapped on a ferris wheel at Coney Island. When they free the squirrel from the wheel, they discover that it seems to be lost, but is reluctant to ask for help. They enjoy the delights of Coney Island as they try to persuade the squirrel.

videos.title: Save the Visitor!
videos.overview: Tuck wakes up in the middle of the night and finds an alien in the classroom—an extraterrestrial! The Wonder Pets form a bond with their new friend, who must return home soon, or be stuck on earth forever.﻿

videos.title: Save the What?
videos.overview: Just when an animal is in trouble, the Wonder Pets' phone is broken (the can was crushed). It's up to the viewer to become a new member of the Wonder Pets and help Linny, Tuck and Ming-Ming figure out what kind of animal is in trouble. Each time the phone rings they find clues. The animal in trouble is a hummingbird whose beak is stuck in an apple.

videos.title: Save the Rooster!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must help a baby rooster "cock-a-doodle-doo" as loud as he can so he can wake the animals up on the farm.

videos.title: Save the Baby Birds!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets head to the tundra where a group of baby birds has no place to perch, except in the antlers of a lonely moose.

videos.title: Off to School!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help their old friend Baby Blowfish overcome her separation anxiety on her first day of preschool, owned by a caring teacher by the name of Mrs. Seahorse.

videos.title: Save the Pirate Parrot!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets set out to reunite a lost parrot with her pirate friend in a clay diorama so they can find hidden/buried treasure.

videos.title: Save the Bengal Tiger
videos.overview: In this Bollywood extravaganza, the Wonder Pets get a call from a young White Bengal Tiger in India who has a thorn in her foot. The team must teach her small things are a big help.

videos.title: Save the Nutcracker!
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, a mouse king emerges from a picture book in the classroom and steals the Wonder Pets' nutcracker present.

videos.title: Join the Circus
videos.overview: It's summer vacation, and the Wonder Pets rescue a young circus lion named Cubby from falling off a circus train. The Penguin Ringmaster is so impressed with the Wonder Pets that he offers them jobs at the circus. But Linny hates this as much as Tuck and Ming Ming and wishes they were heroes again instead of circus performers. But after they rescue the animals from a trapeze they start to miss their home and decide to be heroes again.

videos.title: The Adventures of Bee and Slug!
videos.overview: Little Bee and Slug accidentally take the Flyboat for a ride that quickly gets out of control while the Wonder Pets are going to rescue the Baby Fox.

videos.title: Save the Old White Mouse!
videos.overview: When Bernie the old white mouse gets stuck in a cuckoo clock, the Wonder Pets travel to Linny's grandmother's local nursing home to save him.

videos.title: Save the Glowworm!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a young glowworm named Lucy to find what she's good at glowing!

videos.title: Save the Hound Dog!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Memphis to save a baby hound dog who is stuck inside a jukebox located inside of a large mansion.

videos.title: Save the Rat Pack!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Las Vegas to assist three performing rats who are having trouble working together on their song and a dance routine.

videos.title: Save the Fiddler Crab on the Roof!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets journey to a small village in old Russia to save a fiddler crab who's stuck on a roof.

videos.title: Save the Raccoon!
videos.overview: The Flyboat breaks down during the rescue of a raccoon stuck in a recycling bin. What can the Wonder Pets use to fix it?

videos.title: Save the Loch Ness Monster!
videos.overview: Linny determines a mysterious phone call has come from the Loch Ness Monster nicknamed Nessie in Scotland who needs their help because her flipper is stuck on a rock.

videos.title: Save the Cool Cat and the Hip Hippo!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a cool cat and a hip hippo how to take turns at a jazz performance in Greenwich Village.

videos.title: Tuck & Buck!
videos.overview: Tuck's cool, coordinated, older cousin, Buck, visits the classroom and winds up trapped in the schoolhouse cubby.

videos.title: Save the Mermaid!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets fly into a clay diorama to help a mermaid who wants to be a pirate but learns she must love herself.

videos.title: Save the Pony Express!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets must help a pony in the Old West make her first delivery as part of the famous Pony Express before the sun goes down.

videos.title: Save the Honey Bears!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets journey to Happyland Forest to help two bears named Teddy and Betty learn how to share a pot of honey.

videos.title: Save the Stinkbug!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from a stinkbug who doesn't know how to bathe.

videos.title: The Amazing Ollie!
videos.overview: Ollie the Bunny vanishes into a magician's hat and Wonder Pets must rescue him once again!

videos.title: Help the Monster!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets help a monster who is throwing a tantrum and knocking over buildings in her toy city!

videos.title: A Job Well Done!
videos.overview: To celebrate their one hundredth save, Linny presents Ming-Ming and Tuck with a special home movie.

videos.title: Save the Rhino!
videos.overview: The pets travel to Tanzania to help a baby rhino find a friend.

videos.title: Kalamazoo!
videos.overview: Ming-Ming visits Aunt Eleanora at the local petting zoo during a school holiday.

videos.title: Help the Cow Jump Over the Moon!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from a pop-up book where a young cow from a nursery rhyme is having trouble jumping over the moon.

videos.title: Save the Bat!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Transylvania to help a bat who is afraid of the dark.

videos.title: Save the Donkey!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets head to the Old Globe Theatre to help a donkey who is not prepared for his performance.

videos.title: Help the Easter Bunny!
videos.overview: The Easter Bunny is not so well, so the Wonder Pets must help Ollie fill in for him and save Easter.

videos.title: Save the Visitor's Birthday Party!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to space to attend the Visitor's birthday party.

videos.title: How It All Began
videos.overview: Linny tells Tuck, Ming-Ming, and Ollie the story of how the Wonder Pets first got started. We flashback in time and see how Linny met Tuck and Ming-Ming, how they discovered teamwork, and where all those catchy songs come from! Their first rescue was helping a beached baby whale in Nova Scotia.

videos.title: Save the Lovebugs!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of Lovebugs on Valentine's Day.

videos.title: Save the Skunk Rocker!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.

videos.title: Happy Mother's Day!
videos.overview: It's Mother's Day and the Wonder Pets are taking cookies to Granny Winny (Anne Meara). But upon meeting many moms along the way, they run out of cookies!

videos.title: Save the Sun Bear!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Bali to save a baby sun bear up on a statue.

videos.title: Save Humpty Dumpty!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from Humpty Dumpty who is teetering precariously on a wall in a pop-up book.

videos.title: Save the Meerkats!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Africa and must show a colony of meerkats the joys of voting when they can't agree on how to handle a lurking Jackal.

videos.title: Adventures in Wonderland!
videos.overview: Ollie the Bunny is having a special party in Wonderland but he forgot to invite the guests! It's up to the Wonder Pets to track down the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat and the Queen of Hearts and invite them to the party.

videos.title: Save the Moose in the Caboose!
videos.overview: Ming-Ming draws a colorful story about a moose stuck in a caboose that's headed for a cliff!

videos.title: Climb Everest!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to Mount Everest in Himalaya where, with the help of a goat sherpa, they save a baby snow leopard who's almost endangered.

videos.title: Save the Dancing Duck!
videos.overview: The phone isn't ringing so Ming-Ming decides to explore the classroom in search of action, adventure and drama. But she gets in trouble by finding a pair of magic shoes that can make her dance forever.

videos.title: Save the Dalmatian!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from a dalmatian in a fire station who needs help sliding down the pole before the fire truck arrives.

videos.title: Help the Groundhog!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets travel to a snowy forest to help a groundhog get warm.

videos.title: Help the Lion Cub!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets journey to Africa to help a lion cub learn to pounce and roar for the king. The lion cub dances for the king and he loves it because after many years of the cub pouncing and roaring he gave him something new.

videos.title: Back to Kalamazoo!
videos.overview: When Aunt Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to watch little Marvin, Ming-Ming brings the whole team to Kalamazoo!

videos.title: Bee and Slug Underground!
videos.overview: When Bee and Slug decide to explore what life is like underground, they get stuck in some gooey, sticky mud.

videos.title: Save the Vixen!
videos.overview: Set in a Film noir fashion, The Wonder Pets travel to Los Angeles to help a fox whose diamond-studded collar has mysteriously vanished.

videos.title: Teach an Old Dog New Tricks!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets go to see a vaudeville show and meet an Old Dog performer.

videos.title: Save the Genie!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get a call from a Genie whose lamp has been dented beyond repair. The team flies out to a storybook Arabian desert and rubs the Genie's lamp, setting him free. He thanks the Wonder Pets and grants them each a wish for rescuing him.

videos.title: The Bigger the Better!
videos.overview: Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the incorrect way and becomes enormous! But when the Wonder Pets try to save a little white kitten stuck in their chimney, their big size causes problems.

videos.title: Help Little Bo Peep!
videos.overview: In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep that lives in Puppetland, who's lost her three singing sheep.

videos.title: In the Land of Oz!
videos.overview: The Wonder Pets get caught in a tornado and blown to the magical Land of Oz!
